question: along the band between Visakhapatnam and the new airport, where has the vegetation gone since the plan's baseline

band.note: A 6 km wide study band drawn between the northern edge of the Visakhapatnam built-up area and the new airport at Bhogapuram. It is a sampling frame, not a road alignment and not a plan feature.

method: Same engine as the protected classes: greenest post-monsoon pass per year inside each cell, [2019, 2020, 2021] baseline against 2025, a change must repeat in two consecutive windows to be called one
caveat: Cells are a sampling frame drawn by this project, not a plan feature, not a road and not a boundary. A cell that changed is a place to look, not a permission finding.
